name: Orach (Mountain spinach)

schedule.notes: Succession every 2 weeks for tender leaves. Bolts hot but lasts longer than spinach.
Pick young leaves or whole stems. Older plants get tall (4 to 6 ft) and tough.

harvest.cues: Leaves 3 to 6 in, arrowhead-shaped, brilliantly colored. Before flowering for tenderness.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 3 to 5 days. Color holds when cooked briefly; deeper red varieties dye the cooking water beet-pink.

varieties.name: Magenta Magic
varieties.notes: Vivid magenta-red leaves. Striking in salads and the garden.

varieties.name: Aurora Mix
varieties.notes: Green, gold, pink, and red. Plant for an ornamental edible bed.

notes: Heat-tolerant alternative to spinach for late spring and early fall. Tall flower spikes make excellent cut-flower stems. Self-seeds — pull volunteers or let them run.
